pypi.summary: Pure python disassembler, debugger, emulator, and static analysis framework

reviewed.note: A binary-analysis framework (capa's engine): WriteProcessMemory / CreateRemoteThread / SetWindowsHookEx / ReadProcessMemory are entries of its Windows API symbol tables (impapi); 'mimikatz' and byte patterns are in its tests and its MSVC signature table; vtrace bundles Microsoft's dbghelp.dll / symsrv.dll (symbol server: WSAStartup). Scanner venv only. Attestation as recorded.
